description: SIA stress-balance boundary traces using the verification test F exact solution (Bueler, Brown, Lingle, J. Glaciol. 53(182), 2007) as the input state. One full stress-balance update at t = 0 from the exact steady state; every dumped quantity has an exact reference value in exact_solution.csv.

regenerate.command: cd stage1 && source runs/env.sh && instrument/instrument_sia -Mx 31 -My 31 -Mz 61 -dumps_dir stage1/dumps/sia
regenerate.note: Canonical vertical resolution Mz=61 (matches the PISM manual test F config); horizontal 31x31 keeps file sizes moderate. Override with -Mx/-My/-Mz and -dumps_dir

test_F.state: exact solution at t = 0; enthalpy from exact T via enthalpy_permissive

setup.note_on_theta: Schoof bed-smoothing factor theta = 1 everywhere in the sheet (flat bed)

dump_files.meta.txt: pism revision, config file, grid, command line
dump_files.parameters.csv: stress_balance.sia.*, flow_law.*, constants.*, grid.*, enthalpy_converter.* config keys
dump_files.inputs.nc: all inputs + outputs (usurf, thk, topg, mask, enthalpy, age, uvel, vvel, wvel_rel, strain_heating, diffusivity[2], h_x, h_y, diffusive flux, F_b)
dump_files.columns.csv: per cell-center (i,j,k): geometry, E, computed u3/v3/w3/sigma3, exact T/u/v/w/sigma
dump_files.staggered_D.csv: per staggered point: h_x, h_y, |grad h|, D
dump_files.diffusive_flux.csv: per staggered point: D, grad h, q = -D grad h
dump_files.delta.csv: per staggered point and level: z, depth, pressure, E, stress, flow, delta = e*theta*2*p*flow, D (trapezoid of delta), theta
dump_files.exact_solution.csv: exactFG reference: H and per-level T, U, w, Sig

checks.delta_D_consistency: D in delta.csv equals D in staggered_D.csv to full precision (trapezoidal integral)
checks.theta: 1 for the flat bed inside the sheet
checks.discrete_vs_exact: u3, sigma3 differ from the exact solution by the expected discrete error (max |U| error ~0.23 m/yr at this resolution, same as PISM's own pism_siafd_test at Mx=31)
